caption: The drawing depicts a circular, plate-like object with a decorative border. Inside the circle, there is a reddish-brown horse shown in profile, facing to the left, with a harness and reins depicted in thin white lines. Riding sidesaddle on the horse is a female figure dressed in a green outfit with a matching green skirt and a fitted bodice. The figure has long brown hair and is wearing a brown hat. To the left and right of the horse and rider, floral motifs with green leaves and purple flowers are displayed. The background within the plate is a muted beige or tan color. At the bottom of the composition, the words “Lady okle” are written in a cursive script. The artist's signature, "E.H. Shelcady 1937," appears to the lower right of the image, outside the circle. The entire composition is centered on a plain, light beige or off-white background.
title: Pie Plate
